diagnostics.message: The Lambda permission `:resource.aws_lambda_permission.cur_per_resource` uses a literal function name and can be created before the Lambda in `:module.cur_per_resource`; Lambda must exist before AWS can attach its invoke permission.

The Lambda permission `:resource.aws_lambda_permission.cur_per_resource_process` uses a literal function name and can be created before the Lambda in `:module.cur_per_resource_process`; Lambda must exist before AWS can attach its invoke permission.

The Lambda permission `:resource.aws_lambda_permission.cur_per_service` uses a literal function name and can be created before the Lambda in `:module.cur_per_service`; Lambda must exist before AWS can attach its invoke permission.

The S3 notification `:resource.aws_s3_bucket_notification.cur_notification` configures the process Lambda but does not wait for its invoke permission `:resource.aws_lambda_permission.cur_per_resource_process`. S3 notification configuration can fail unless that permission is already in place.

The export `:resource.aws_bcmdataexports_export.cur_per_resource` targets the billing bucket but has no ordering dependency on its policy `:resource.aws_s3_bucket_policy.cur_bucket_policy`, which grants BCM Data Exports the required bucket access. Ensure the policy is attached before configuring the export.

The export `:resource.aws_bcmdataexports_export.cur_per_service` targets the billing bucket but has no ordering dependency on its policy `:resource.aws_s3_bucket_policy.cur_bucket_policy`, which grants BCM Data Exports the required bucket access. Ensure the policy is attached before configuring the export.
